description: Normalisation rules for bio_data.family entries (task 044g). Universal — subject-independent.

family_entry_format.description: Each family entry must follow <Relation>: <ФИО> format with optional parenthetical note.

relation_terms.description: Canonical Russian relation terms in именительный падеж (nominative).
relation_terms.note: Add двоюродный/троюродный modifier before term as needed, e.g. «Двоюродная сестра»

locative_case_note.description: Cities named in bio_data fields (birth_place, death_place, lived_in) must use prepositional (locative) case — «в Калинине», not «в Калинин».
locative_case_note.rule: Use standard Russian prepositional case for city names; do NOT use nominative/accusative after «в».

malformed_entry_handling.description: Entries that cannot be parsed into relation_term + full_name are flagged.
malformed_entry_handling.fix: If relation_term is empty/unknown, skip entry in rendering; log to validation report.
